rows.label: Sales, marketing & overhead
rows.description: Selling, general and administrative expense generally includes personnel-related costs, including payroll, stock-based compensation and commissions for our sales force, marketing and advertising expenses including media, market research, marketing materials, clinical education, trade shows and industry events, legal and outside service costs, equipment, software and maintenance costs, depreciation and amortization expense and allocations of corporate overhead expenses including facilities and IT.

rows.label: Making & delivering what they sell
rows.description: Cost of net revenues includes personnel-related costs including payroll and stock-based compensation for staff involved in the production process, the cost of materials, packaging, freight and shipping, depreciation on capital equipment and facilities used in the production process, amortization of acquired intangible assets and training costs.

rows.label: Research & development
rows.description: Research and development expense generally includes personnel-related costs, including payroll and stock-based compensation, outside service costs associated with the research and development of new products and enhancements to existing products, software, equipment, material and maintenance costs, depreciation and amortization expense and allocations of corporate overhead expenses including facilities and IT.

items.label: Lower rate on export profits (FDII)
items.note: Profits from selling to customers abroad are taxed at a reduced US rate

items.label: Profits taxed at lower foreign rates
items.note: Profits booked in lower-tax countries. Not a US break, but it lowers the overall bill

items.label: Research & development credit
items.note: A federal credit for spending on research

groups.label: Contracts
groups.note: The government buying products and services

groups.label: Grants
groups.note: Money for projects, such as research or factories

groups.label: Loans & loan guarantees
groups.note: Expected cost to taxpayers of loans the government made or backed
